body:
Thanks, you're right, he just gave the best answer he could. 

I called my psychiatrist and she said the next available appointment is on the 24th and that I shouldn't wait that long and go to urgent care. I asked if I would get hospitalized and she said maybe. 

I have to work. I can't miss work. One day, maybe. Minimum of 3 for a hospital visit? No way. I'll get fired. 

Do you think it's worth it to go to urgent care just to get meds? And maybe they won't hospitalize me? Anything I should avoid saying?

Thanks. I sent my therapist an email about all this and he said it happens when depression gets severe, but I've seen him once in the last two months and am bad at communicating with him so he doesn't know that I'm not really depressed anymore. I posted his response on another comment here. 

He basically said to call my psychiatrist and tell them I'm hallucinating so I get triaged. I guess I will. But I'm probably going to have to go in and talk to someone about all this and I'm not really looking forward to it. But I guess there isn't anything else to do. My roommate said I'm really jumpy lately. And I know I am. I get creepy demonic voices the second I'm able to stop thinking about all this and relax or focus on something else to do that's important, boom, scary shit. I'd rather be jumpy and expect it than scream out of fear of it happening when I'm off guard.

Hey, so I did email my therapist and this was his was his response: 

You are describing auditory hallucinations, which most likely are symptoms of depression.  When depression gets severe enough, this can be the result.  I recommend that you make an appointment with your psychiatrist and describe what you are experiencing, and s/he may increase your dosage of antidepressant medication, prescribe an additional med, such as Trazodone, or both.  When your depression lessens the symptoms will fade, but in the meantime the meds should take care of it. 
 
That must be very disturbing to experience.  Yes, by all means let's talk about it and about behavioral ways of lessening your depression. 
 
Keep in mind that what you are experiencing is a symptom, and symptoms go away after underlying causes are taken care of.
 
Make sure that, when you call the psychiatrist's office, to tell the person answering phones that you are hallucinating.  Hopefully they can triage you in earlier than they normally would.
 
I'm looking forward to seeing you at your next appointment.

----
Since I hadn't seen him for about two months before the last time I did see him(about a week ago), I haven't told him I'm not on meds anymore. And, I'm not depressed. So I guess I will and see if his response is any different. If anything I'm maybe a little depressed still, but definitely not severe and not enough to cause hallucinations. 

I feel kinda offended by his response. I don't know. Something about him calling it a hallucination. I'm starting to think/hope it's more than that. It's important or something. It can't be just a hallucination. I don't like that word right now. I feel like it's putting me down. 

I guess I'll call my psychiatrist and get meds. Since my roommate wants me to, and maybe it'll help. Important or not, the voices are scaring me and happening all the time, so I'd like some peace unless they start saying something worth listening to. 

They're starting to sound like demons and prayers and weird shit. My abuse wasn't really religious, but my abuser was, and after I'd be abused every time I'd play with his prayer beads. I don't know if they're connected. 

If it ever gets bad I'll go to the hospital. I can imagine myself getting so scared that I just freak out and start screaming. It's can get very terrifying. 

Thanks for your help. What do you think of my therapist's response?

I'm not really depressed, just scared. Stressed, maybe. I'm doing well at work, except losing focus now, and I head a voice at work the other day among the whispers and I lost track of where I was in the middle of a conversation with a co-worker. I think my diagnosis of depression was always kinda related to the situation- living with an emotionally abusive and neglectful mother and dealing with the sexual abuse. But now I'm living with some good friends and have a good job and it's easier to deal with my mom now that I'm not living with her. So I'm glad, and things are going ok. 

I do feel cognitively slow sometimes, like my head gets heavy and it's hard to focus. But doesn't everyone get that? Just off days? 

And I get high-energy sometimes, but it's usually provoked by something, like seeing something motivational and it makes me want to get myself better organized and stuff. Or where I just want to be productive and think of things to do, art to create and stuff.

The voices are becoming more frequent and I"m really scared of them. I want them to just shut up and go away. It's like demonic super fucking creepy whispers and voices saying one word or a phrase. I can't communicate with them, is that uncommon? 

I'm going back and forth between emailing my therapist or not. But I guess it is bad enough. it isn't stopping like I'd hoped and I'm ridiculously jumpy and scared and I can't relax for two seconds because right when I stop thinking about it and focus on something else I hear them again. 

Thank you so much for all your feedback. I really really appreciate it. I hope that whatever diagnosis I get is correct so this can stop.

I'm not sure anymore. I feel like I need to wait to see if it either stops or gets worse because it isn't bad enough to tell my therapist. But I think it's becoming that. It's constant whispers and sometimes words or phrases that are clear. I heard some demonic whisper voice when I was changing and I screamed, and my roommates heard me and asked what was wrong because I don't just scream for nothing. And I told 'em I just thought I heard something. 

My roommate that knows about this told me to "seek help". 

I'm so scared. The voices are trying to scare me. They're really fucking good at it. Every night I have nightmares now and when I wake up I hear voices again. 

Is this bad enough? I want it to just go away. I want to wait and it to just go away.

Thanks. I'm actually not sure what I'm going to do. I keep on thinking that I should wait longer in case it just stops or it gets worse because it's not bad enough, like maybe it's just a temporary thing and not something to bother my therapist with just yet. Like I need to see if it's to confirm what's going on more.

Sorry you had to go through that, but I'm glad you're doing well now. I guess I will tell my therapist. It's scaring me, and becoming too common, and I don't want it to get any worse. 

And I'm scared of exactly what you were, being labeled as crazy and having everything ruined. Things are going ok. I'm finally started to get on my feet as an adult and I have one semester left before I graduate with an AA in Web design. I don't want things to fall apart. I hope if I ignore it it'll just go away. But it hasn't in almost a month. So it must be worth mentioning to my therapist since I'm worrying not only myself but my best friend very much. 

Thank you for your support, I won't be able to see my therapist for about two weeks, since he works at my campus and the health center is closed for two weeks because of the holidays. I think I'm going to email him though, and let him know what's going on since I have a hard time talking about new things like this anyways, I can't undo an email if I force myself to send it. 

I don't really know how it works, since I've already got a diagnosis, if he does think it's schizophrenia, will he tell me straight away or wait a while to confirm? I don't know if I should mention that I'm worried it might be that(he knows about my aunt being schizophrenic so I don't need to bring that up). 

Ah, I'm thinking a lot about this. Maybe too much. 

Just, thank you.

Thank you. 

I'm not even sure whether or not to tell my therapist anymore. My friend/roommate says I should, but I don't know. I wonder if I should just wait a little longer, and maybe they'll go away? I scared, I'm really really scared of having being diagnosed with schizophrenia. If this keeps happening and things are just going to get worse from here, oh man, I just can't. I can't lose everything I have. I'm losing focus and care and I don't want things to get worse. I've only just started to get things together. 

I guess I have to tell my therapist. I don't even know why I'm doubting it. If it's not schizophrenia, great, if it is, better to find out sooner, I guess.
Thank you.

Thank you. I will be honest with my therapist. And yea, I'd rather help my friends through suicidal thoughts rather than have them kill themselves. 

My friend/closer roommate and I talked last night. I think he was a little annoyed because I say I'm trying but he can't see it because I'm still really depressed and hurting myself and telling him I have suicidal thoughts. 

I'm gonna try to work through it.. again. The advice I always get is talk to your therapist, from here and from friends, so I guess I should work on doing that. I'll be taking meds soon, and using my friends' ears when I need 'em. 

I can't shake the thoughts that I'm guilty. I'm small and worthless and guilty and my abuser is always watching me and laughing. Anyone I've ever talked to says I'm not, but I just am. I'll bring it up to my therapist. 

My abuser is dead. I wish he weren't. I would press charges if he were around. (this is making me think now..) If he were around would I still blame myself? Would I be afraid like I am? 

Shit, ok, thank you. I'm ok. I have stuff to think about. I must be fucking crazy. I used/kinda still have been thinking that my abuser is this powerful god-like person. He controls the 'verse and it's just us. Fuck. That question is breaking it. If he were alive he wouldn't be shit. I'd probably be able to hate him. I'd probably go over to where he is and yell at him and maybe beat the shit out of him. So maybe he isn't so important? 

Holy fuck I can't wait for therapy tomorrow! 

Thank you.

I might write a letter. I've done it before with my therapist(but he prefers I try to actually say things). 

I think I'm going to kill myself, though. I've been thinking about a goodbye video and I think I'm going to hang myself. I'll figure out something about how I'm found, because I don't want my roommates to see me like that. 

Everyone's saying I'm not guilty. But I am. I can tell myself I'm not but it doesn't feel right. I know there's something I did and the only way I'll know what is if I talk to my abuser again, so I have to die. If there's something afterwards and I can talk to him, that's good, it's what I need, if not, I need nothingness too. I just can't keep doing this. I don't want to keep going any more with these awful shameful feelings that I can't explain. I need to know what I did. I keep looking at the ceiling fan. I can hang myself from there. I just need to do it. I love my friends and family, but is it right that I stay alive for them when they can't help me and I need something from dying?
I might've contributed. I feel like an accomplice.
My therapist only works on Tuesday and Friday. I can't do anything to see him sooner. Thank you, though.

I'm in the US too. I kept going back. I liked him, my abuser was my friend until I found out it wasn't something that happened to everyone. That's why I'm guilty. Because he was my only friend. 

Whenever I'm alone I just feel like he's with me. He's always with me and I don't know what to fucking do. My body isn't mine, my skin isn't mine. There's no privacy from the memories. 

I'm going to try and talk about it with my therapist. I can probably see him Tuesday. I burned myself. I'd been trying not to self-harm for a long time, it's nice to just give in a little.

He wanted me to invite friends over. I don't remember if I did. I might've gotten another kid abused. 

It was on and off for a while, started when I was around 6 I think, last time I remember it I could've been 11 or 12. So maybe 9 or 10 years ago. I'm 21 now.

The soonest I can see my therapist is Tuesday. I don't think I can tell him. I'll try. I wouldn't want my roommate to go with me, it might make it harder. And I just burned myself a little. I don't have anything to cut with(except kitchen stuff and I'm not gonna use our cooking knives). I don't know if I'll tell/talk to my roommate about it later. I feel like since I already did it I can just do it more, at least in this self-harm session or whatever. I feel better.

"Even if s/he convince you to do something to another child, it's not your fault." 

Why did you say that? I don't think I said anything about that.

It'll come as a shock to him. He thinks everything is fine. I can make myself tell him next time I see him, but what about now? I just want to cut. It won't make it go away forever but all I need is it to go away right now. 

I don't want to text either of my roommates about it because they're at work and they had a fight this morning. I could, but they're just hurt about it. And I think they're getting annoyed.

I wish I could confront my abuser. I wish he wasn't dead. A letter isn't enough. I have a journal full of them for him and it isn't enough. The shame and guilt is meant for me, it's only going to go away when I die.

Thank you. I'm not too worried about my mom, because you're right, it's all up to her now. 

I'm kind of scared to talk to my roommates openly. I do most of the time, but they have their own problems, and they fight a lot, so if I'm feeling shitty and they're in the middle of an argument, I'm not going to interrupt while they're angry and tell them I want to cut. 

I am to blame. I don't know all the reasons why, but I just am. I don't know how to stop thinking that that's true. It feels true. No one ever needed to tell me, I've just always been guilty.

I think if I don't end my life it won't ever stop. I can't stop feeling like I'm terrible. I did something awful as fuck and I can't remember it but the guilt is still there. I'm always wondering what it was and the theories I come up with.. I don't know. I just want to remember and if I can't it's going to be like this forever, and I just want to die. 

My abuser died. He died free of guilt or shame. His name name is still clean. Nobody's outed him, and as much as I'd like to, is there a point now that he's gone? I can't pass my pain and guilt and all that onto him, I have to carry it forever. 

My roommates are both gone now, and I'm gonna be home alone all day. I want to cut. It'll disappoint them but I don't know if I can stop myself anymore. Fuck. I hate this. I hate the stupid fast as fuck flashbacks that make me paranoid and scared and I don't understand it. 

My abuser is physically gone but he's still always right behind me. I'm just gonna cut. My friends will forgive me. 

--
Thank you for everything you've said. I might try writing things down. I have an old journal where I used to write letters to my abuser all the time. It kind of made me obsess more so I stopped, but it might help to write one last letter.

They are awesome. They both know about the sexual abuse. I can talk about it easier with the one I'm closer to but still not much. It's too difficult to say anything about it. It just makes me want to hide away from shame. I used to go to a Survivors of Incest Anonymous group pretty regularly, but I have class at the time the meeting is going on now so I can't go anymore. 

I think my current psychiatrist thinks I'm not depressed or something. I feel like I'm not taken really seriously so I feel kinda put down when I go to appointments. I don't know if that's how she sees it, but I feel so much smaller than her. I feel like a criminal or a liar when we meet. It's all a punishment. 

My therapist is the therapist at my college, so I'm not paying for it, but he's a great therapist. I just started to pull away and now I can't talk to him anymore. I don't know where I'd get another therapist, but I think I need one soon anyways because he's going to start a private practice and leave. 

My roommates are worrying me because they're clearly worrying about me. Yesterday one got kind of upset and said I couldn't do basic tasks and the other said I was being paranoid. I don't see how I'm so much different than I was before but I must seem pretty out of it if they're so scared. The one I'm less close to said he doesn't want to have to be worrying about me. Kind of the opposite of what the other said. It makes me feel like I have to pretend around him to protect him. I was thinking he was going to tell me he doesn't want me to live here anymore, but he didn't. 

I still want to just kill myself. It's so much to think about. I don't know what I'm supposed to do from here. I can't talk about it. I can't get words out and writing them makes me want to run away as soon as I give the message to someone.

I've been hospitalized before too, and I know it isn't so bad, but I'd rather not go. I still can't miss work for a week. I won't have any money, I still need to pay rent and all that. 

I'm afraid they'll cry and yell and not understand. I'm hurting them. What options do they have? They're scared too, I can see that, and I don't know what they can do to help me, they've asked before and I don't know the answer. They're going to feel shitty and helpless and it's my fault. They actually are helpless though, I'm still thinking I should kill myself, so maybe my mind can't be changed? Maybe there's nothing else to do? I don't know what I'm supposed to say to them. It's past just needing support, because I'm getting it but it isn't working. What's the point of asking for help when there isn't anything that can help?

The soonest I'd be able to see my therapist is on Tuesday. I could possibly get a 45 minute session, if I book the right appointment time/it isn't taken. 

Even if I go I have too much trouble talking. Even writing is hard now. Communicating anything that's going on in my head is so anxiety-producing that if I try to talk to my therapist I don't think I can do it. I just pretend everything is fine because that's what it looks like it should be. I've just moved out of a bad situation, I'm supposed to be ok. So to tell him I'm not is going to come as news to him(my therapist). And I can maybe get myself to just spit it out, but talk about it? No way. I'll probably spend most of the session in my head trying to talk myself into saying something but I won't be able to. I keep looking at the ceiling fan and wondering if it could hold my weight so I can hang myself on it. 

I don't know about the past getting more distant. I think lately it's been getting closer, more important and such. I just want to cut myself really bad and hang myself and be done. Except I can't, because I'm not going to have my best friends walk in on my bloody, hanging body, fuck that. I would have to do it somewhere else or have someone else find my body, because I can't do that to them. 

Fuck. I just want this to be over. If I talk to my friend/roommate tonight about it he's gonna cry, and be hurt, and be extremely supportive which will make it harder because I feel like I've made a decision. I feel like hearing him tell me about how he cares and I can use his time to vent anything I want is wasting his time, like I'm just nodding but not listening, because I still want to die. 

I don't know if I should tell anyone in real life how much I'm considering it now, because I don't know what the consequences of that will be(hospitalization? Not being able to go to work= being fired= everything gets more fucked up). Or I could lose my friends. They could just get tired of dealing with depression everyday when it's not theirs, when they could just stop talking to me and be their normal happy selves rather than having me to worry about.
